full_name: Jennifer Bornstein | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Independent Artist
bio: Jennifer Bornstein is an artist living in Berlin and New York City. Bornstein works in diverse media, including video, 16-millimeter film, sculpture, and etching.
